```{r,echo=FALSE}
# sqrt(x)+a = b
while(T){
    a = sample(1:15,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    b = sample(1:15,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    if((b-a)>1 && (b-a)<13){
        break
        }
}
eq = paste0("\\sqrt{x}+",a,"=",b)
eq = gsub("+-","-",eq,fixed=T)
x = (b-a)^2

if(a>0){
    wrd = paste0("Subtract ",abs(a)," from both sides.")
} else {
    wrd = paste0("Add ",abs(a)," to both sides.")
}

eq2 = paste0("\\sqrt{x}=",b-a)


eq3 = paste0("\\sqrt{",x,"}+",a,"\\stackrel{?}{=}",b)
eq3 = gsub("+-","-",eq3,fixed=T)


eq4 = paste0(round(sqrt(x)),"+",a,"\\stackrel{?}{=}",b)
eq4 = gsub("+-","-",eq4,fixed=T)

```

Solve.

Solution
========


`r wrd`

$$`r eq2`$$

Square both sides.

$$x=`r x`$$

Check the solution in the original equation.

$$`r eq4`$$
